name: C4 Context Diagram (Level 1)
description: C4 Context Diagram (Level 1) describes the system overview: main users (Person), the system being built (Software System), and external systems (External System). This is the starting point for every C4 model.
purpose: Define system scope, main users, and interacting external systems.
bestFor: Present high-level architecture to non-technical stakeholders
First step when applying the C4 model
notSuitableFor: Describe technology in detail → go to Level 2 (Container)
Describe internal components → go to Level 3 (Component)
Describe entity in detail → go to Level 4 (Code)
useCases: Draw interaction relationships between Person ↔ System
requirements: Relationships — interactions between Person and System

elements.name: Person
elements.description: Main user of the system (customer, admin, operator)

elements.name: External System
elements.description: External system that interacts (payment gateway, email service)

confusableWith.difference: C4 Context focuses on system and external; Use Case focuses on actors and detailed functionality.
C4 Context at overview level; Deployment at deployment infrastructure level.
